warmstart_repository_provenance_freeze.definition:
columns sorted by name; each row rendered as the ASCII-0x1F join of repr() of its values and hashed with SHA-256; the resulting MULTISET of row hashes is sorted (duplicate multiplicity preserved, no de-duplication) and joined with '
'; the sorted-column-name list is appended after '|'; SHA-256 of that, first 16 hex chars.
warmstart_repository_provenance_freeze.why_multiplicity_preserving: a set-based hash would call two repositories identical when one contains a duplicated warmstart row and the other does not; multiplicity is scientifically meaningful because warmstart rows are ranked per record.
warmstart_repository_provenance_freeze.conclusion: the warmstart repository is content-identical across M0-M3; the two distinct raw file hashes (M0+M3 vs M1+M2) are a parquet serialisation artefact.
